name: Richard Lionheart
bible: A young knight-king and master swordsman with a disciplined, noble fighting style. Golden-blond hair, swept back and wild, falling to the jaw at the back; determined blue eyes; a handsome, focused face. Regal polished SILVER plate armour with GOLD trim and engraved gold filigree: layered rounded pauldrons, a breastplate, articulated gauntlets, greaves and pointed sabatons. NAVY-BLUE undersuit and trousers showing at the joints and thighs. A long IVORY tabard with gold embroidery hangs front and back from a dark belt with a gold buckle. A long CRIMSON cape with a gold border and a slightly tattered hem flows from the shoulders. WEAPON: an ornate longsword with a golden LION-HEAD crossguard, a navy-and-gold wrapped grip and pommel with a blue gem, and a steel blade with a glowing sapphire-blue fuller. He grips it in his RIGHT hand; the left hand joins on the grip for heavy two-handed strikes. His sword energy and weapon trails are BLUE-WHITE arcs with GOLD sparks.

sheetNotes.art: Radiant Cleave: he gathers blue-white and gold light into the sword (anticipation), then hurls a huge crescent wave of blue-white light forward with a mighty horizontal sweep (execution), the wave leaving the blade toward the right edge of the cell; recovery with the sword lowered, light motes fading.
sheetNotes.misc: Taunt: he points the sword forward at the opponent, then raises his chin with a confident half-smile. Victory: he plants the sword point-down in front of him with both hands on the lion crossguard, cape flowing, a regal calm look; a soft blue-gold glow.
sheetNotes.ko: Intro: he walks in with the sword lowered at his side, raises it in a knightly salute before his face, swings it down in a flourish, and takes his stance.
sheetNotes.skill: Lion's Roar, his own special (a royal war cry that throws close enemies back). 1: he plants his feet and lifts the longsword high overhead, blade vertical, chin up, mouth opening for a shout. 2: the sword drawn back beside his head, the sapphire fuller and gold sparks gathering, the cape snapping out. 3: he drives the blade down in front of his chest and roars, a golden LION-SHAPED shockwave bursting outward from him in gold and blue-white rings. 4: the roar at full force, the lion-head wave filling the cell out to its margin, his body braced, the cape flaring back. 5: the wave fading into drifting gold sparks, the sword lowering. 6: back in stance with the blade held across the body.
